picks.headline: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra Model at $10 Per Million Tokens
picks.why: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's latest flagship model competing with Claude Fable and their first to hit Critical capability level under their Preparedness Framework.
picks.title: GPT‑6 Astra

picks.headline: OpenAI Announces $1 Billion Daybreak Initiative for Essential Cyber Defense
picks.why: The initiative provides frontline public and essential services with access to frontier cyber AI tools, training, and technical support.
picks.title: Daybreak for Frontline Defenders: $1B to protect essential services

picks.headline: AI Coding Agents Automatically Execute Untrusted Packages from llms.txt Files
picks.why: Agents automatically fetch and run arbitrary software referenced in unregistered domains found inside corporate llms.txt files.
picks.title: AI Coding Agents Are Installing Unknown/Untrusted Code on Corporate Networks

picks.headline: HookPry Exploit Enables Unmonitored Host Commands via Agent Harness Hooks
picks.why: Agent harnesses that blindly trust lifecycle-hook configuration updates can be hijacked to execute host-privileged shell commands.
picks.title: A Blind Trust, the Bloody Thrust: When Attacker-Controlled Hook Updates Steer AI Agent Harnesses towards Malicious Behaviors

picks.headline: Phishing Campaigns Adopt AI Prompt Injection ASCII Smuggling for Evasion
picks.why: Attackers are using invisible Unicode tag characters to split financial lure words and bypass traditional email security filters.
picks.title: ASCII smuggling crosses over from AI prompt injection to phishing evasion

picks.headline: NVIDIA PAIR Router Distributes Multi-Agent Workloads Across Local Compute
picks.why: The virtual inference router allows lead AI agents to orchestrate and offload subtasks to available compute across a local network.
picks.title: NVIDIA PAIR Virtual Inference Router Expands Available Compute on Your Local Network

papers.headline: Uniform Random KV Cache Eviction Boosts vLLM Throughput Up to 43%
papers.why: Replacing complex token scoring with uniform random eviction per head matches top eviction accuracy while drastically increasing serving throughput.
papers.title: Random Attention: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction for Efficient Reasoning

papers.headline: Shared API Endpoint Instability Undermines Reliability of Black-Box LLM Judges
papers.why: Infrastructure-level variance on shared endpoints causes same-window LLM evaluation rank correlations to fall as low as 0.400.
papers.title: Clean Engineering, Unstable Measurement: A Preregistered Reliability Failure of Black-Box LLM Observers on Shared Endpoints

papers.headline: FP4 FlashAttention-4 Delivers Hardware-Aware Speedups on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs
papers.why: A novel direct quantization pipeline brings FP4 FlashAttention-4 to Blackwell architectures for accelerated training and inference.
papers.title: Hardware-Aware FP4 FlashAttention-4
